map.Less 变量是编译期替换，作用域遵循「就近优先、延迟求值」：变量可在定义之后被: Less variables are substituted at compile time, and their scope follows "closest wins, lazy evaluation": a variable can be reassigned after its definition and the last assignment wins, so a definition written after its use still applies — which is counter-intuitive.
